ide.sudut: Mengangkat tren micro-drama berseri berdurasi agak panjang. Narasi horor sejarah tanpa wajah tentang kapal Carroll A. Deering yang ditemukan tanpa awak, menggunakan visual foto arsip tua yang dianimasikan halus serta sound design ambien laut yang pekat.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Penonton luar negeri menyukai misteri sejarah nyata (true mystery) dengan pembawaan atmosferik dan cliffhanger cerita yang memicu rasa penasaran untuk episode berikutnya.

ide.judul_kerja: 3 AM Rain in an Abandoned Japanese Shrine
ide.sudut: Pengalaman ambien audio-visual 9:16 yang menggabungkan visual hujan berulang di kuil tua dengan narasi bisikan (ASMR horror narration) berbahasa Inggris tentang legenda urban abad ke-18.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Memberikan perpaduan unik antara relaksasi dan sensasi merinding (cozy-scary vibe) yang sangat disukai audiens global pencinta konten ambience.

ide.judul_kerja: The Forbidden Audio from the Paris Catacombs (1890)
ide.sudut: Mengadaptasi tren micro-storytelling dengan format doku-horor cepat. Menggunakan rekaman suara vintage buatan, efek dokumen tua, dan peta 3D tanpa menampilkan wajah untuk menceritakan eksperimen suara terlarang abad ke-19.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Memanfaatkan daya tarik audiens internasional terhadap tempat-tempat ikonik bernuansa kelam dan misteri sejarah yang belum banyak diketahui.

hasil.hook: On January 31, 1921, a massive ship was found completely abandoned... with dinner still warm on the kitchen table.

naskah.narasi: On January 31, 1921, a massive ship was found completely abandoned... with dinner still warm on the table.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Glitch Effect] FOUND WITHOUT A CREW

naskah.narasi: This was the Carroll A. Deering, stranded near the dangerous waters of Cape Hatteras.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Fade-in Effect] The Carroll A. Deering (1921)

naskah.narasi: When rescuers finally boarded days later, they expected a tragedy... but found something far stranger.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Slide-up Effect] No Crew. No Signs of Struggle.

naskah.narasi: All lifeboats were missing, navigation logs were gone, yet a prepared meal was left totally untouched in the galley.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Typewriter Effect] Freshly cooked food... left behind.

naskah.narasi: Was it a violent mutiny? Rogue pirates? Or did the mysterious Bermuda Triangle claim another victim?
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Zoom-in Effect] Mutiny? Pirates? Or Something Else?

naskah.narasi: Even a full FBI investigation couldn't solve it. To this day, not a single crew member has ever been found.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Shake Effect] Case Unsolved for 100+ Years

naskah.narasi: What do you think happened to the 11 missing men? Comment your theory below and follow for Episode 2!
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: by Agung] [Pulse Effect] WHAT HAPPENED TO THEM? (Follow for Ep. 2)
